actionClasses: Kubernetes local host mapping and service forwarding
description: Reviews classic kubefwd service-forwarding commands that can change local /etc/hosts, bind loopback addresses and connect to a Kubernetes cluster. Idle-mode, API and MCP operations are outside this rule's scope.
name: kubefwd service-forward protection
saferAlternatives: Review the active kubeconfig context, selected namespace and services, and elevated local host-file changes before forwarding; prefer a test cluster.
